```{r setup, include=FALSE, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(knitr)
library(l1ou) # this needs to be downloaded from github
library(reshape2)
library(ggplot2)
library(geiger)
library(dplyr)
library(phytools)
library(plyr)
#library(coin)
library(Momocs)
library(ggpubr)
```

# Main Figures
```{r, label="import spores",results="hide", echo=F, cache=T, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Import outlines: First list jpeg files to import

jpg.list <- list.files("outlines", pattern=c( ".jpg"), full.names=TRUE) 

# import them

spores <- Momocs::import_jpg(jpg.paths = jpg.list, auto.notcentered = T)
out_spores <- Momocs::Out(spores)
out_spores <- Momocs::coo_center(out_spores)
out_spores_scaled <- Momocs::coo_scale(out_spores)
out_spores_smoothed <- Momocs::coo_smooth(out_spores_scaled, n = 5)
# Ensure all outlines have the same number of points (e.g., 100 points per outline)
out_spores_interp <- Momocs::coo_interpolate(out_spores_smoothed, n = 120)
# Now apply Procrustes alignment
out_spores_aligned <- Momocs::fgProcrustes(out_spores_interp)
# Visualize to confirm
panel(out_spores_aligned, title = "Aligned Amanita Spores after Resampling")
efourier_spores <- Momocs::efourier(out_spores_scaled, nb.h = 10, norm = TRUE)
pca_spores <- Momocs::PCA(efourier_spores)

```

```{r}
# ===============================
# PCA Plot for Amanita Spore Shapes
# ===============================

# Save PCA plot as PNG
png("PCA1_2_Amanita_Spore_Shapes.png", width = 3000, height = 3000, res = 300)
plot_PCA(
  pca_spores,
  axes = c(1, 2),
  palette = NULL,
  points = TRUE,
  points_transp = 0.7,
  morphospace = TRUE,
  morphospace_position = "range",
  chull = TRUE,
  chullfilled = FALSE,
  labelpoints = FALSE,
  labelgroups = FALSE,
  legend = TRUE,
  title = "",
  center_origin = TRUE,
  zoom = 1.3,
  eigen = TRUE,
  box = TRUE,
  axesnames = TRUE,
  axesvar = TRUE
)
dev.off()


```

```{r}

pca_scores <- pca_spores$x  # This gives you the principal component scores

library(ggplot2)

# For the first few PCs
for (i in 1:5) {
  p <- ggplot(data.frame(PC = pca_scores[, i]), aes(x = PC)) +
    geom_histogram(aes(y = ..density..), bins = 30, fill = "skyblue", color = "black") +
    geom_density(color = "red", size = 1) +
    ggtitle(paste("Distribution of PC", i)) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

  # Save the plot
  ggsave(filename = paste0("PC", i, "_distribution.png"), plot = p, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
}

```


```{r}
# Calculate the proportion of variance explained
variance_explained <- (pca_spores$sdev^2) / sum(pca_spores$sdev^2) * 100

# Create a data frame for plotting
variance_df <- data.frame(
  PC = factor(paste0("PC", 1:length(variance_explained)), levels = paste0("PC", 1:length(variance_explained))),
  Variance = variance_explained
)
```


```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# Bar chart for the first 10 PCs (or adjust number as needed)
ggplot(variance_df[1:10, ], aes(x = PC, y = Variance)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", Variance)), vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "Variance Explained by Each Principal Component",
    x = "Principal Component",
    y = "Percentage of Variance Explained"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

```



```{r}
# Scree plot for all PCs
ggplot(variance_df, aes(x = as.numeric(gsub("PC", "", PC)), y = Variance)) +
  geom_line(color = "red") +
  geom_point(size = 2, color = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    title = "Scree Plot: Variance Explained by PCs",
    x = "Principal Component",
    y = "Percentage of Variance Explained"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))


```


```{r}
ggsave("variance_explained_bar_chart.png", width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)
ggsave("scree_plot.png", width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```
